correctness.rationale: A full five-edge upper bound follows from 2r<=3(9-r). A three-column tangent argument proves every size-five matching is uniquely the tangency matching of two intersecting nonvertical affine lines, giving 27. An explicit nine-row local overlap table establishes four two-edge swaps per optimum. The 18 triangles have an explicit 3-net incidence model and reconstruct the original Pappus graph; hence the exchange graph is its line graph. Two independent Python programs, using affine incidence versus LCF host and five-subset versus maximal-clique enumeration, fully check the classifications and all 351 pair distances. The finite calculations do not purport to prove an infinite-family statement.
